title: Can Model Answer Probabilities Represent Survey Populations? Conditional Prediction and Joint Validity in Jev Survey Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.15576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Survey simulations require realistic combinations of answers, but predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a model can generate them. We evaluate the option probabilities returned by Jev, a TypeSafe decision model, using linked responses to 20 binary items from five archived survey waves. We compare population-only prediction, prediction given recorded answers, and sequential completion that uses generated answers to predict later responses. Joint comparisons hold the starting population information fixed, and two three-question cases are completed in both question orders. We evaluate predictive scores, answer frequencies, and associations against the survey records. Recorded answers can improve predictive scores while associations remain distorted. translated_title: 模型答案概率能否代表调查总体？Jev调查模拟中的条件预测与联合有效性
translated_abstract: 调查模拟需要真实的答案组合，但仅凭预测准确性并不能证明模型能够生成这些组合。我们使用来自五轮存档调查中20个二元题目的关联回答，评估了TypeSafe决策模型Jev返回的选项概率。我们比较了仅基于总体信息的预测、给定已记录答案条件下的预测，以及利用生成答案来预测后续回答的顺序补全。联合比较将起始总体信息保持固定，两个三问题案例以两种题目顺序分别完成。我们对照调查记录评估了预测得分、答案频率以及答案间的关联性。结果表明，已记录的答案可以改善预测得分，但答案间的关联性仍然失真。较大的条件预测误差也会出现。例如，在自述具有传统价值观的男性中，模型预测只有16%的人会认为男性和女性相似。
tldr: 该论文评估了Jev决策模型的答案概率能否真实代表调查总体，发现尽管已记录答案能提升预测得分，但答案间的关联性依然失真且存在较大的条件预测误差，表明预测准确性不足以保证调查模拟的联合有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper evaluates whether Jev decision model's answer probabilities can realistically represent survey populations, finding that although recorded answers improve predictive scores, answer associations remain distorted with large conditional errors, showing predictive accuracy alone cannot ensure joint validity in survey simulation.
